{{Quote|&hellip;praise be to the space-gods.|[[Zeta Magnus]]|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
The '''space-gods''',<ref name="Is This the Final Chapter?">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> also known as the '''gods of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]''', were a pantheon of [[Deity/Legends|deities]] worshiped by the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]].<ref name="New Planets, New Perils!" /> It was thought that their kindness could influence the outcome of battles.<ref name="Is This the Final Chapter?" /> They never gave any sign they heard the chants of their [[Priest/Legends|priests]], but it had never been recorded that they had promised to do so.<ref name="New Planets, New Perils!" />
